summary: Verified backend security fixes SEC-001 (Pydantic Field bounds min_length=1/max_length=100 on client_name; GET /api/status bounded to .to_list(100)) and SEC-002 (CORS: allow_credentials=False when wildcard origin is used). Wrote 9 pytest cases covering root, valid create + persistence, over-long (300) rejection, empty rejection, boundary 100/101, list bound, and CORS actual+preflight header checks. All 9 tests passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
Consider adding a max page size / pagination params to GET /api/status instead of a hard-coded 100 for future scaling.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' is fine for a public demo but should be tightened to explicit domains for production; the allow_credentials guard is correctly implemented.
seed_data_creation: One StatusCheck row created via POST /api/status with client_name='qa-tester' plus 2 boundary rows (100-char, additional short); all persisted in test_database.status_checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend security tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes.py and can be re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes.py -v. The KineticCourt frontend does not call the backend; the FastAPI service is a bundled starter only.
rca of the issue: N/A - verification-only task; both SEC-001 and SEC-002 fixes behave as specified.
